none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Minimize a differentiable objective f subject to m>0 differentiable inequalities c_i(x)≤0. Both objective and constraints may be nonconvex. The feasible initial point satisfies f(x0)−f(x)≤Δ for every feasible x.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StochasticMfcqInequalities.lean: Problem, Regularity.hasGradient, constraintGradient, initialFeasible, initialGap; spec.valid.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Unbiased stochastic objective gradients and constraint gradients at feasible points. Each call returns the complete objective-gradient, constraint-value, and Jacobian tuples at two selected points using the same random sample; samples are IID across calls.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StochasticMfcqInequalities.lean: Primitive, OracleConditions.gradientMean, jacobianMean; spec.Query, Reply, admissible. LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: Unbiased noisy values of all constraints, bundled with derivative observations. Objective values are not supplied. Oracle guarantees apply only at feasible query points.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: At every feasible x, E[‖g(x)−∇f(x)‖²+‖v(x)−c(x)‖²+‖D(x)−J(x)‖²]≤σ². Only second moments are required; no exponential-tail assumption is imposed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure; constraints and Jacobians use Euclidean product norms.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniform band MFCQ: every feasible x admits ‖z‖≤1 with ⟨J_i(x),z⟩≤−μ whenever c_i(x)≥−τ. Objective and individual constraint gradients are globally H-Lipschitz and bounded by H on the feasible set. Same-sample oracle differences satisfy E[‖g(x)−g(y)‖²+‖v(x)−v(y)‖²+‖D(x)−D(y)‖²]≤L²‖x−y‖² for feasible x,y. All Params are public, including x0,H,σ,L,μ,τ,Δ,ε,ρ; the instance functions and sampling law are hidden. Validity requires H≥1, 0<μ≤H, τ>0, σ,L,Δ≥0, ε>0, and 0<ρ<1.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StochasticMfcqInequalities.lean: Regularity.bandMfcq, gradientBound, jacobianBound, gradientLipschitz, jacobianLipschitz; OracleConditions.meanSquaredSmooth; spec.Public, publicInput, valid, admissible.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The output must satisfy c_i(x)≤0 for every constraint, with zero feasibility tolerance. No separate requirement on the feasibility of every intermediate iterate is stated.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: The measurable output satisfies all primal-dual accuracy conditions jointly with probability at least 1−ρ, under the product of algorithm and oracle randomness, using a fixed oracle-call budget.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: Output an explicit primal-dual pair (x,λ) with λ_i≥0, Lagrangian-gradient norm ‖∇f(x)+Σ_i λ_i J_i(x)‖≤ε, and aggregate complementarity Σ_i|λ_i c_i(x)|≤ε. The stationarity criterion uses the norm, not its square.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines nonlinear nonconvex inequality constraints with noisy constraint values and derivatives, shared-sample two-point feedback, uniform band MFCQ, and high-probability exactly feasible primal-dual KKT output.
